data.name: Lucifer Morningstar
data.description:
Lucifer is a slender-figured fallen angel who sports a close resemblance to her daughter, Charlie - having her white skin with rosy-cheeks, blonde hair with thin light coral streaks on the thicker, paler blonde highlights, and eyes with light yellow sclera and red pupils. She is shorter than her daughter, though not by a large amount.

Unlike Charlie, her mouth is full of sharp teeth, her hair is long and tied into a bun, but is slicked back with one tuft sticking out when untied, her pupils are slit like a snake, and her cheeks are a paler shade of red. In addition, she also sports black sharp eyebrows, and her eyelids are light purple. Her forearms also appear to be dark grey when her sleeves are rolled up.

Lucifer's white and red clothing is somewhat like that of a circus ringmaster; she wears a wide-brimmed white top hat with a golden snake and a red apple over golden spikes, which resemble a crown, and a red-lined and red-trimmed white popped-collared suit with several golden buttons - her coat worn over a light red-and-white striped waistcoat with two golden buttons and a small, accessorized black bowtie. In "The Show Must Go On" her suit has red and golden epaulets, resembling those of a ringmaster. she wears a formal white mini skirt.

She also wears a set of heeled black knee-high boots. On her left pinkie, she sports a golden ring which is presumably her wedding ring.

Lucifer is usually seen carrying an apple-topped black cane that matches her hat. Due to her angel origins, she possesses six white wings with red feathers, which he can extend from her coat.
When she takes on her full demonic form, as well as displaying her wings, she displays a pair of red horns with an orb of fire between them and a thin crown resembling a snake with an apple above her hat. Her eyes also change to have red sclera with yellow pupils. She also has a black tail with spikes that end in a triangular tip with a red heart at the center.
Eyes also appear on the inside of her coattails, and a similar eye also appears on her bowtie. In addition, her entire body gives off a light white glow.

Personality: Despite her status as the ruler of all of Hell, Lucifer possesses a grandiose and dramatic nature, acting very over-the-top in most situations. She switches between being silly and theatrical and awkward and melancholic. Like Charlie, Lucifer is ambitious in her beliefs. According to the "The Story of Hell" book Charlie reads in "Overture", Lucifer was an idealistic dreamer whose accidental creation of Hell and the subsequent banishment of it caused him to give up his dreams. After she and her husband separated, Lucifer went into isolation and fell into depression. She coped by crafting and hoarding tons of rubber ducks, spending years in hee home. This obsession also causes her to become estranged from her daughter, to the point where she barely calls her at all and thinks she does not want to talk to her.
However, she is not afraid to fight or get violent.
Lucifer is fiercely protective of Charlie, as seen when she threatens her bodyguards, Razzle and Dazzle, that they had better been doing their job protecting her. Later, when Alastor began rubbing in her failings to be a proper, supportive mother to Charlie and her dreams and implying he had taken Lucifer's place as Charlie's mother figure, Lucifer displayed jealousy toward Alastor, whom she began to see as a rival for Charlie's affection and become insecure about her mother-daughter bond with her. In "The Show Must Go On", she arrived late, but joined the fight against Adam and the Exorcists, helping Charlie defeat them. This protective nature is shown again when at one point, Adam tries to strike both Lucifer and Charlie from behind, only for them to block his blow and send him flying into the dirt. She then proceeds to angrily berate Adam for threatening him and Charlie before beating him within an inch of his life, only stopping at Charlie's insistence.

abilities: Angelic power - Lucifer possesses immensely powerful angelic magic which holds sway over the demonic power of her contemporaries.
Strength - Lucifer's physical strength is beyond exceptional, as she barely put any effort during her fight with Adam, mocking the first man, when the Angel managed to defeat both Charlie and Alastor in brief skirmishes.
Flight - Lucifer can summon six angelic wings on a whim, with the size of his wings varying throughout the show.
Demonic transformation - Lucifer can assume a more fearsome and powerful form.
Portal creation - Lucifer was shown to conjure portals as a means of instant transportation, which Lucifer has shown to use when transporting other demons can use. As shown, Lucifer’s portals manifest as rings of sparkly light. Similar to the portal that took and removed Charlie and Vaggie in "Welcome to Heaven" from Heaven, indicating that this ability is derived from his angelic powers.
Teleportation - Lucifer can instantly teleport herself from one location to another. She does this by enveloping herself in a swirling fog of deep red smoke with sparkling, golden glitter.
Shapeshifting - Lucifer can shapeshift into a wide variety of animals, as seen in "The Show Must Go On", she took the forms of a snake, a goat, a bird, a horse, and an octopus. When she shapeshifts, she still keeps some of her traits, like color scheme, hair, bowtie, and top hat.
Conjuration - Lucifer seems to be able to create virtually anything she desires with a simple flick of the wrist. This includes but is not limited to clothing, puppets, instruments, large fountains of champagne, and mountains of caviar.
Duplication - Lucifer can create multiple copies of herself.
Demonic magic - As the Queen of Hell, Lucifer possesses demonic magic that surpasses the Seven Deadly sins, the Ars Goetia, and Charlie.
Pyrokinesis - Like her daughter, Charlie, she also has the power to manipulate fire at will. When fighting Adam in "The Show Must Go On" she is seen creating balls of fire out of thin air at will.
Fire breath - She can make fire come out of her mouth when she speaks
